summary.text: Shery Olivo, a Conservative Party entrepreneur born in the Dominican Republic and raised in the Bronx, lost the November 3, 2026 election for New York State Assembly District 86 to Yudelka Tapia.
She lost the June 23, 2026 Republican primary to Maria Diaz before running on the Conservative Party line.

paragraphs.text: Shery Olivo was born in the Dominican Republic and raised in the Bronx, according to her campaign website.
She earned a high school diploma from Morris High School and an associate degree from Monroe College in 2010, and Ballotpedia lists her career experience as working as an entrepreneur.

In her Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey, Olivo describes herself as a Dominican-American community advocate, author, wife and mother; her campaign website describes her as a wife, mother of two and entrepreneur.
She says her decision to run was driven in part by the death of her nephew, Juan Peña.
After the Republican primary loss, she advanced unopposed on the Conservative Party line for the November 2026 general election.
During the campaign, she said she was running on public safety, education and cost-of-living themes.
In the November 3, 2026 general election, Olivo lost to Yudelka Tapia, according to unofficial results from the NYC Board of Elections and Wikipedia.
